Added batch category edit for selected transactions on Android (FeedScreen selection toolbar) and web (TransactionList batch bar). Reused the existing batch-select-and-delete UI pattern on both platforms. Introduced a category-only PATCH path (CategoryPatchDto / id=in.(...) filter) instead of a full-row PATCH to avoid corrupting toWallet/toAmount on transfer rows, since TransactionUiModel does not carry those fields (a pre-existing gap in the single-edit sheet, left untouched). Split TransactionRepositoryImpl into a same-directory helper file (TransactionCategoryBatchUpdater.kt, TransactionEntityMapper.kt) to satisfy the 150-line R9 repository cap.

Added day-precise custom date range and multi-wallet selection to the Insights page (web only), so a non-calendar cycle like a salary month (26th-25th) across multiple wallets (e.g. BBL + Mandiri CC) can be reported combined, split by currency. Replaced the Custom preset's month-granularity inputs with type=date inputs, and replaced the single-wallet select with multi-select toggle chips (empty selection = All wallets, matching prior default). Extracted a shared walletCurrency() helper into constants/transaction.js (previously duplicated in TransactionList.jsx) to bucket per-wallet raw transaction rows by currency for the combined-wallet aggregation path. Kept the existing getMonthlyOverview() fast path for the common case (calendar-month preset, no wallet filter) unchanged; the new per-wallet getTransactions() raw-row path only kicks in for custom date ranges and/or explicit wallet selection.

Added click-to-expand category drilldown on the Insights page (web only): clicking a Spending Breakdown row expands it to show the individual transactions behind that category's total, scoped to the currently active period/date-range/wallet filters. On-demand fetch (getTransactions with a category filter) rather than pre-loading all raw rows, so the getMonthlyOverview fast path for the common calendar-month/all-wallets case stays untouched. Only one category expands at a time (single {currency,key} state); changing filters while expanded refetches automatically via the same effect dependencies as the main summary fetch.

Added Transfer In/Transfer Out visibility to Insights (web only), addressing that Mandiri CC 'PAYMENT THANK YOU - Livin' payments (transfer tx_type) were silently excluded from any total. Deliberately kept as a SEPARATE stat from Income/Expenses rather than merging, since merging transfer-in into Income and transfer-out into Expenses would double-count internal transfers when All wallets is selected (source and destination both in scope) - confirmed with the user before implementing. Transfer In/Out are computed per-wallet via the existing wallet OR-filter (wallet=X OR (transfer AND to_wallet=X)) that getTransactions already supports, classified by comparing each row's wallet/to_wallet against the queried wallet. Extended to the getMonthlyOverview fast path too via a second, independent fetch, so transfers show even for the default calendar-month/all-wallets view. Both Transfer In and Transfer Out are clickable and expand to show the underlying transactions, reusing the category-drilldown mechanism from the previous session with a pseudo-key namespace. Noted (pre-existing, unrelated): WalletBalances.test.jsx has a failing assertion confirmed present on the last committed master too - not caused by this work.

Added a new Card Debt page (web only) tracking Mandiri CC and BCA CC charges as per-transaction debt (Paid/Partially Paid/Unpaid), addressing that the existing Balances page only shows an aggregate running total with no per-charge visibility. Deliberately computed client-side (fetch all raw transactions for the wallet, run FIFO in JS) rather than a stored paid_amount column, since this user repeatedly re-imports and corrects historical statement data mid-session - a derived/recomputed-on-read model can't go stale, whereas a persisted allocation would need migration/backfill logic and could drift after retroactive edits. FIFO settles oldest-unpaid-first and processes charges+payments+refunds in true chronological order, so a payment can only settle charges dated on or before its own date (not future charges). Added a limit override param to getTransactions() (default 200) since this page needs full wallet history, not the last-200 cap used elsewhere. Confirmed design with user first (per their explicit request) before writing any code: per-transaction tracking (not just aggregate), partial-payoff shown with remaining balance, scoped to both CC wallets, web-only for now (not Android).

Fixed a real year-computation bug in the shared PDF parser (web/src/utils/pdfParser.js, used by both the live Import PDF UI and scripts/parse_bank_statement.mjs): parseBcaCc/parseBcaSavings defaulted every row to the CURRENT calendar year with no month-rollover handling, so a January-dated BCA CC statement's December transactions were stamped with the wrong (current) year instead of the previous year. Fixed by extracting the statement's own printed month/year (TANGGAL REKENING for BCA CC, PERIODE for BCA Savings) and rolling the year back for any row whose month is later than the statement's month. Confirmed via a full recheck of all 13 statement PDFs under ~/Downloads against the DB: BCA CC matches perfectly (66/66 expense rows). Mandiri CC has real discrepancies to report to the user: ~30 missing /bin/zsh BUNGA CICILAN rows (no financial impact), one likely hand-transcription amount error (Tops charge off by 4,999 IDR), 4 charges genuinely missing from the DB (~8.3M IDR combined), and 4 DB rows not found in any of the 6 statement PDFs (need the user's input on whether these are legit notification-captured entries or stale duplicates) - none of this has been touched, only reported. Also added a billing-cutoff checkpoint feature to the Card Debt page per user follow-up request: shows unpaid balance as of each past statement cutoff (11th for Mandiri CC, 3rd for BCA CC, both inferred from the statements' own printed dates), reusing the existing FIFO computeDebt function by filtering rows to date<=cutoff before running it.

Investigated the Mandiri CC discrepancies flagged by the recheck: found and fixed a second real parser bug (parseMandiriCc) — a purchase Mandiri converts to an installment plan (IPP) posts as a full charge immediately followed same-day by a 'Convert to IPP <merchant>' CR reversal of the identical amount; the original parser didn't recognize this pair, so 4 of the 'missing from DB' charges flagged in the recheck (Google Runna Running, CLAUDE.AI, REVEDITION, SHOPEE, totaling ~8.3M IDR) were false positives — inserting them would have double-counted debt already correctly billed via the separate NNN/NNN installment rows. Added cancelIppConversions() to net out same-date/same-amount charge+reversal pairs before returning parsed rows. Re-ran the recheck after the fix: those 4 false positives are gone. Remaining real findings reported to the user, none touched: ~30 missing /bin/zsh BUNGA CICILAN rows (no financial impact), 1 confirmed hand-transcription error (id=11 'Tops - CP - S26' should be 1,373,079 not 1,378,078, confirmed against raw statement text), 2 unexplained DB rows (id=425/426 'VE Cash Wdr'/'VE SA Cash Wdr Charges', ~1.24M IDR combined) not found in any of the 6 statement PDFs' text, and 3 likely notification-capture duplicates (id=1255 'Bolt', id=1259/1260 'Grab Soljum' x2) — same date and a consistent ~0.75% amount gap vs already-imported statement lines for the same merchant/date, consistent with FX-rate timing drift between real-time notification capture and statement posting.
